chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: Mae West sends for Bubbles at the Chinese Theater
summary: Mae West asked him to teach her steps and be in a picture, and he did not call her; he tells of her sending for Gorilla Jones.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Once they asked for me -- Mae West, she asked for me at the Olympic Gardens when I went there to see Gorilla fight. She had her maid with her, sent the maid over to tell me that she wanted to see me. I says for what? She said, I don't know, she just wanted me to tell you she wanted to see you and if see don't get to see you she's gonna see Gorilla Jones. You tell her you better get Gorilla Jones for her. So they got Gorilla Jones, she went and got Gorilla Jones. So they made a date. But Gorilla Jones don't know they made a date. He don't know I know she sent for him. All he knows is that they come for him, but she done bid for

me first.
Well, I was back in Gruman's
Chinese Theater when she drove up with her
chauffeur to have her secretary to come in and
ask for me playing at the Chinese Theater and
when they come to ask for me, I says, "What is
it?" Says, "Miss West wants to see you out in
the car." I said, "Buck, whistle for me, Miss
West is outside." Whistle for me when it's
time to go on. I go out to the car. She tells
the driver to take a walk and let me in. She
sat in the back seat. When I got in, she had
her legs crossed up to here. You understand?

Above her knee,
yeah, understand? She had her legs crossed above
her knee. When I got in the car there ain't no
way to miss seeing her legs. She sent the
secretary to tell me if I wanted to do a picture
-- she wanted to learn to dance, that's it. She
wanted me to teach her a few steps, that was it.
When I get in the car, she wanted to know if I

wanted to go in this picture she had. I says, I don't know, but if you want to ride around until I do my act and come out, I can let you know. She says, "Here's my card, when you get a chance, you can give me a ring." Did you call her? Did you call her? I didn't call her. I didn't call her. But the next day I went down to the Dunbar Hotel where Gorilla Jones was livin' --
